iu1: Add a person with all properties, their city, three interests, one university, one company and five friends.
iu2: Add a like from a person to a post.
iu3: Add a like from a person to a comment.
iu4: Add a forum with its moderator and three tags.
iu5: Add a person as a member of a forum.
iu6: Add a post with its creator, forum, country and three tags.
iu7: Add a comment with its creator, country, two tags and the post it replies to.
iu8: Add a knows edge, with its creation date, between two persons.
w_del_e: Delete one knows edge between two persons who know each other.
w_del_v: Delete a person together with all the edges that touch it.
w_del_v_record: Delete a person's record and its index entries, leaving its edges in place.
w_ins_e_facet: Add a knows edge carrying its creation date between two persons who do not know each other yet.
w_ins_e_plain: Add a knows edge, with no properties, between two persons who do not know each other yet.
w_ins_v_full: Insert a new person with all of its properties, including the indexed ones.
w_ins_v_min: Insert a new person with only three non-indexed properties.
w_upd_dated: Change the creation date of a person, a property with a date index.
w_upd_edge: Change the creation date on one existing knows edge between two persons.
w_upd_indexed: Change one indexed property (first name) of a person.
w_upd_multi: Change three properties of a person in one update, one of them indexed.
w_upd_plain: Change one non-indexed property (last name) of a person.
